verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents 96 GB of GDDR7 memory and positions the card for running LLMs and AI agents locally. It also cites an FP8 Transformer Engine that accelerates LLM inference, and 96 GB is ample capacity for a 70B-class quantized model on a single card. A community multi-card build reports high-throughput inference (41k tok/s), though one commenter notes SM120 lags in mainstream library support. Missing for 10: a published memory-bandwidth figure (only PCIe Gen5 host bandwidth is cited), an explicit 70B-model benchmark or claim, and independent single-card 70B inference corroboration.
